# TubePilot

> TubePilot is an AI-powered YouTube Creator OS designed to help YouTube creators create, optimize, schedule, and grow their content.

Official Website: https://www.tubepilot.shop/

## About TubePilot

TubePilot is a platform built specifically for YouTube creators. It brings AI-powered content creation, video optimization, scheduling, and channel insights into one platform.

## Core Features

- AI Video Ideas: Generate content ideas for YouTube videos.
- AI Title Generator: Generate engaging YouTube video titles.
- AI Description Generator: Create YouTube video descriptions.
- Hashtag Tools: Help creators with relevant hashtags.
- SEO Optimizer: Optimize YouTube video content for search.
- Tags and Metadata: Improve video metadata.
- Thumbnail Workflow: Support thumbnail creation workflows.
- Visual Analyzer: Analyze visual content.
- Video Upload: Upload videos through TubePilot.
- Smart Scheduling: Schedule YouTube videos.
- Video Analytics: Understand video performance.
- Channel Audit: Review YouTube channel performance.
- Competitor Radar: Explore competitor-related insights.
- TubePilot MCP: Explore TubePilot's MCP-related integration.

## Who Is It For?

TubePilot is designed for:
- YouTube creators
- Content creators
- YouTube beginners
- YouTube channel owners
- Creator teams
